On Oct. 3, Aleph Alpha released Kolibri’s full weights under Apache 2.0; the English–German model has 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active per token.

Aleph Alpha reports aggregate scores of 75.5% in English and 70.8% in German, below dense Qwen3.8 at 80.2% and 79.9%; its report documents training up to 256K tokens against a 1M-token advertised inference limit.
